tools.name: sitekick_site_list
tools.description: List sites currently authorized for this account.

tools.name: sitekick_site_inspect
tools.description: Inspect the selected site and its available authoring capabilities.

tools.name: sitekick_site_create
tools.description: Create a site using the original idempotency key. Reuse that key when explicitly recovering an uncertain creation.

tools.name: sitekick_project_create
tools.description: Create an explicit SiteKick design project from a complete blueprint, optionally refining an existing release. For native WordPress generation preserving custom themes/plugins, use workspace.write with action plan.

tools.name: sitekick_project_get
tools.description: Read the exact project revision and blueprint.

tools.name: sitekick_project_update
tools.description: Update the project using its expected revision and complete blueprint.

tools.name: sitekick_project_seal
tools.description: Seal the expected project revision for generation.

tools.name: sitekick_job_start
tools.description: Explicitly start a durable generation job for the sealed project after reviewing project.estimate cost context. Pass its estimate_hash as reviewed_estimate_hash; changed revision or pricing requires renewed review. Actual child requests reserve credits and settle usage. Reuse the exact original comm

tools.name: sitekick_job_get
tools.description: Read durable job status and progress. Token expiry does not imply job cancellation.

tools.name: sitekick_job_cancel
tools.description: Explicitly request cancellation of the selected durable job.

tools.name: sitekick_job_retry
tools.description: Explicitly retry a failed job using the supplied retry identity.

tools.name: sitekick_release_prepare
tools.description: Prepare an immutable release from the completed job.

tools.name: sitekick_release_get
tools.description: Read the immutable release and its manifest.

tools.name: sitekick_release_preview
tools.description: Request a preview. Follow the returned WordPress login continuation when an owner browser session is required.

tools.name: sitekick_release_review
tools.description: Prepare a publication review. Human approval requires the returned browser continuation and an actual owner session.

tools.name: sitekick_release_activate
tools.description: Activate exactly the browser-approved release using the returned publication_request. A tool confirmation cannot issue approval.

tools.name: sitekick_release_rollback
tools.description: Roll back exactly the browser-approved release using the returned publication_request. A tool confirmation cannot issue approval.

tools.name: sitekick_template_list
tools.description: List reusable templates using the returned pagination cursor.

tools.name: sitekick_template_get
tools.description: Read the selected reusable template.

tools.name: sitekick_template_create
tools.description: Create a reusable template from the selected immutable release.

tools.name: sitekick_release_review_get
tools.description: Read review status by exact review ID and hash. If approved, retain the returned publication_request and use its exact operation, approval and idempotency identity.

tools.name: sitekick_binding_choices
tools.description: List authorized native binding choices by kind and page. Retain the opaque choice token; native IDs are not exposed.

tools.name: sitekick_binding_enroll
tools.description: Enroll one opaque binding choice for this site using the original idempotency key.

tools.name: sitekick_project_estimate
tools.description: Review estimated generation credits for this exact current sealed project revision. Full-blueprint planning coverage includes all pages and assets, including potentially reused refinement pages. This is not a reservation ceiling or exact refinement charge. No generation starts. tools.name: sitekick_site_existing_list
tools.description: List currently owned existing websites as opaque choices. Use the selected page and choice token; native IDs are never input.

tools.name: sitekick_site_existing_select
tools.description: Select one currently owned existing website using its opaque choice token and original idempotency key. Registration does not adopt or publish it.

tools.name: sitekick_adoption_capture
tools.description: Request an existing-site capture using the exact assessment hash and original idempotency key. Follow the returned WordPress continuation and explicitly confirm with an owner browser session; this does not publish.

tools.description: Inspect native WordPress source as paged inventory metadata (offset/limit), or fetch only selected file bytes with paths. Use get/status to continue a saved workspace project. tools.description: Plan, update, generate, validate, preview, review, apply, roll back, cancel or retry native WordPress changes in the selected isolated site. Start with plan, request and kind; omitted appearance_mode preserves customizations. Load selected existing source with source_paths, then scope overwrites/del

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "sitekick_workspace_write" is 866 chars, far longer than this server's median (110). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: sitekick_release_review_get, sitekick_workspace_write · Private data: sitekick_job_get, sitekick_binding_choices, sitekick_site_existing_list, sitekick_site_existing_select, sitekick_workspace_read, sitekick_workspace_write · Public sink: sitekick_site_existing_select, sitekick_adoption_capture.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: sitekick_release_review_get, sitekick_workspace_write · Private data: sitekick_job_get, sitekick_binding_choices, sitekick_site_existing_list, sitekick_site_existing_select, sitekick_workspace_read, sitekick_workspace_write · Public sink: sitekick_site_existing_select, sitekick_adoption_capture

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
